_comment: Written when the agent must stop mid-task (rate limit, STOP file, crash). On next /improve-mod run, the agent reads this first and resumes the same task_id at the recorded phase instead of re-claiming a new one.
resume_command: MERC_BATCH_OPENINGS="$(cat ../agent/openings/mercenary.csv)" MERC_BATCH_MAX_PLIES=120 MERC_BATCH_LIVE_PROGRESS=1 MERC_BATCH_REPORT_PATH=../agent/reports/mercenary/20260419-031200.txt flutter test test/manual_mercenary_audit_batch_test.dart --run-skipped -r compact
